description: Test whether conserved residues of the Knh4 Kre9/Knh1 domain form an exposed carbohydrate-binding surface patch or a buried Ig-like hydrophobic core
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
M=pd.read_csv('knh4_domain_conservation_sasa.csv')
# atom coords again
rows=[]
for l in open('knh4_domain_17_115.pdb'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        rows.append((int(l[22:26]), l[17:20].strip(), l[12:16].strip(),
                     float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['num','res','name','x','y','z'])
sc=A[~A.name.isin(['N','C','O'])]           # CA + sidechain
cen=sc.groupby('num')[['x','y','z']].mean()
M=M.set_index('resnum').join(cen).reset_index()

# ---- conserved-surface-patch scan: for each exposed residue, mean conservation of exposed residues within 10 A ----
exp=M[(M.rsa>=0.20)].dropna(subset=['x']).reset_index(drop=True)
t=cKDTree(exp[['x','y','z']].values)
patch=[]
for i,r in exp.iterrows():
    nb=t.query_ball_point([r.x,r.y,r.z], 10.0)
    sub=exp.iloc[nb]
    patch.append(dict(center=f"{r.aa}{int(r.resnum)}", n=len(nb),
                      mean_cons=sub.frac_identical.mean(),
                      members=",".join(f"{a}{int(n_)}" for a,n_ in zip(sub.aa,sub.resnum))))
P=pd.DataFrame(patch).sort_values('mean_cons',ascending=False)
P.to_csv('knh4_surface_patch_conservation.csv',index=False)
print("=== Top conserved SURFACE patches (10 A sphere, exposed residues only) ===")
print(P.head(8).to_string(index=False))
print("\nmean conservation of all exposed residues:", round(exp.frac_identical.mean(),3),
      " | buried residues:", round(M[M.rsa<0.10].frac_identical.mean(),3))
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,p=mannwhitneyu(M[M.rsa<0.10].frac_identical.dropna(), exp.frac_identical.dropna(), alternative='greater')
print(f"Mann-Whitney buried > exposed conservation: U={u:.0f}, p={p:.2e}")

# ---- Y76 / Y102 geometry ----
def ring(n):
    s=A[(A.num==n)&(A.name.isin(['CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ','CH2','NE1','CE3','CZ2','CZ3']))]
    return s[['x','y','z']].values.mean(axis=0)
import itertools
arom=[76,102,105,83,17]
print("\nRing-centroid distances among exposed/partial tyrosines (A):")
for a,b in itertools.combinations(arom,2):
    print(f"  Y{a}-Y{b}: {np.linalg.norm(ring(a)-ring(b)):6.2f}")

# ---- acidic residue conservation (GH catalytic pair test) ----
print("\n=== Conservation of domain Asp/Glu (candidate catalytic acid/base) ===")
print(M[M.aa.isin(['D','E'])][['resnum','aa','frac_identical','entropy','rsa','top3']].to_string(index=False))

# ---- FIGURE ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(M.resnum, M.frac_identical, color=np.where(M.rsa<0.10,'#2b5d8a','#d98c34'), width=0.9)
for n in [40,78,90,106,102,76]:
    y=M.loc[M.resnum==n,'frac_identical'].values[0]
    ax.annotate(f"{M.loc[M.resnum==n,'aa'].values[0]}{n}", (n,y), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Residue number (Knh4)'); ax.set_ylabel('Fraction identical in 471 fungal homologs')
ax.set_title('Conservation along the Kre9/Knh1 domain\nblue = buried (RSA<0.10), orange = exposed')
ax=axes[1]
col=np.where(M.aa.isin(list('WYF')),'#b23a48','#9aa5b1')
ax.scatter(M.rsa, M.frac_identical, c=col, s=34, edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.3)
for n in [40,78,90,106,102,76]:
    r=M[M.resnum==n].iloc[0]
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{n}", (r.rsa, r.frac_identical), fontsize=8, xytext=(3,3), textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvline(0.25, ls='--', c='grey'); ax.set_xlabel('Relative solvent accessibility')
ax.set_ylabel('Fraction identical'); ax.set_title('Conserved aromatics (red) are buried,\nnot an exposed binding platform')
ax=axes[2]
cath=pd.Series({'2.60.40.10\nIg-like':538,'2.60.40.150\nC2-like':91,'2.60.40.3330':13,
                '2.60.120.290\nGalactose-bd':11,'other':870-538-91-13-11})
ax.barh(cath.index[::-1], cath.values[::-1], color='#2b5d8a')
ax.set_xlabel('Foldseek hits (CATH50, domain-only query)')
ax.set_title('Fold assignment of the Knh4 domain:\nimmunoglobulin-like beta-sandwich')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
